title: Filing-page source corpus backfilled for the full ticker universe
points: financial_documents_new and filings_fts_new were missing 333 of the 471 tickers in the database. The statement spine (financial_statements via 13_d1_push) and ratios (15_ratios) were rebuilt for all 471 tickers during the universe expansion, but the page/document corpus is published by a separate per-ticker step (17_publish_documents) that was not run for the new tickers — so numeric answers for those companies could appear without source page previews and full-text search could not retrieve their filings.

All 333 missing tickers were published into financial_documents_new and filings_fts_new from existing review/ (search_text summaries + section tags) and markdown_pages/ (full page text). No re-parse, re-review, or re-extract was required — the metadata and search_text were already on disk.
Reviewed page PDFs and their thumbnails were uploaded to the remote source host (R2) so source links and previews resolve under source.psxgpt.com for the backfilled tickers.

Root-cause fix: step 17 (publish documents) and step 18 (publish assets) are now documented in the pipeline spec and wired into run.py as the documents chain, so a future universe expansion publishes the source corpus alongside statements and ratios instead of silently lagging behind.

The backfill flow now computes the financial_statements-vs-financial_documents_new gap directly from D1 with 17_publish_documents.py --gap, then uses 18_publish_assets.py for thumbnails and R2 source assets.
